run_KMeans: run K-means clustering on a point cloud tensor using PyKeOps and return cluster labels and centroids
run_match_kcrosscheck: run k-nearest neighbor cross-check matching between two descriptor tensors using FAISS to find mutual matches
run_matches_ratiotest: run ratio test matching between two descriptor tensors using FAISS to filter matches by distance ratio
run_load_scene: run load_scene to load a scene from disk, predict depth planes with a UNet, and extract SIFT/ORB/SuperPoint features
run_prematch_scene: run prematch_scene to compute pairwise feature matches across all image edges in a scene using FAISS and fundamental matrix filtering
